description.value: Olive This & More is an interactive olive oil and balsamic vinegar tasting room in Qualicum Beach, one of three Vancouver Island locations (also Nanaimo and Langford). Staff guide visitors through an extensive selection of ultra-premium extra virgin olive oils sourced from both hemispheres and 12-to-18-year aged Modena balsamic vinegars produced via the traditional Solera system. The shop also carries specialty oils, artisan salts and rubs, olives, olive oil skin care, and gifts.
